contributionLog.detail: Bo qua phan tim nguon. NGUYEN NHAN da do ra: KHONG phai thieu quyen — search_web cua agy chay tot (25,8 giay). Loi nam o prompt: luot review khong he duoc giao viec tim kiem, yeu cau do chi nam trong file vong cua tac gia. Da va co che 2026-09-11.

contributionLog.what: nop 3 URL, ca 3 deu KHONG tai duoc nhu nop
contributionLog.detail: Sau khi viec tim kiem duoc chen thang vao prompt moi luot, Gemini chay 401 giay (lan truoc 104) va co di tim that. Nhung: (1) ice pick — file Commons CO THAT nhung duong dan truc tiep sai hash, Claude phai tra API moi lay duoc; (2) Half Moon Hotel — URL api.urbanarchive.org tra 404, trang nguon 403; (3) mugshot — ten mien khong phan giai duoc, va la trung voi thu Codex da nop. Gemini tu ghi ro la khong tai file ve kiem duoc do chay che do chi doc — dung, va day chinh la ly do spec tach foundBy khoi verifiedBy.
contributionLog.correction: Gemini neu diem D10 rang muc nay ghi sai vi no CO dong gop. Dung mot nua: dong gop o luot nay, khong co o luot truoc. Da tach thanh hai ban ghi theo tung lan chay thay vi mot ket luan chung.

lessons: HTTP 200 KHONG bao dam file du. Ba lan tai dau deu cut giua chung ma curl khong bao loi: anh Reles dung o 22KB (dang le 121KB), anh canh sat dung o 14KB (dang le 239KB). Nhin bang mat thi ra anh den si hoac chi mot dai pixel. PHAI kiem duoi file JPEG ket thuc bang FFD9 sau khi tai.

URL do agent khac nop la UNG VIEN, chua phai tu lieu. Trong 4 URL Codex nop: 1 la thumbnail qua nho phai doi sang ban dan xuat lon hon, 1 khong phai anh. Luot review chay che do chi doc nen ho khong tai ve kiem duoc — day la viec cua luot tac gia.
gambinoName: LOI KE DUNG TEN VE SAU. Transcript 0:30 viet 'the future boss of the Gambino family'. Nam 1940-41, gia dinh nay la gia dinh MANGANO; Anastasia len lam trum 1951, ten Gambino co tu khi Carlo Gambino nam quyen 1957. Chu 'future' trong loi ke da ngam thua nhan dieu nay. He qua cho anh: moi anh tu lieu mang ten 'Gambino family' tren Commons thuoc 1960-2000s, KHONG dung lam can cu hinh anh cho canh 1940. Khong sua loi ke (viec cua Tu) — chi ghi lai de khong ai lay anh FBI 1981 lam mau.
